name: search_evidence
description: Search the evidence index for passages about an ancient site. Returns cited passages with a relevance score.

query.description: What to look for, in plain English, e.g. 'ramp sledge wet sand'

site.description: Site id: giza, uruk, mohenjo or qin. Leave null to search all sites.

system.description: One of the 9 system ids, e.g. transport_lifting. Leave null for all.

name: get_claims
description: Get verified, graded claims (ancient practice, modern equivalent, lesson, evidence grade) for a site and system.

site.description: Site id: giza, uruk, mohenjo or qin. Null returns every site.

system.description: One of the 9 system ids. Null returns every system.

name: estimate
description: Estimate duration and labour for a build: years, people and person-days from quantity, crews and rates.

quantity.description: How much gets built, e.g. 2300000 blocks

crews.description: Number of crews working in parallel

rate_per_crew_day.description: Units one crew completes per working day

name: haul_force
description: Force needed to drag a load on a sledge up a slope, and how many people that takes.

mass_kg.description: Mass of the load in kg

slope_deg.description: Slope of the ramp in degrees, 0 for flat ground

friction_coeff.description: Sliding friction coefficient (assumed), e.g. 0.3 for a sledge on wetted sand

pull_per_person_n.description: Sustained pull one person manages, in newtons (assumed), e.g. 400

name: carbon
description: Embodied carbon (cradle to gate) for a volume of material, using ICE Database factors. Known materials: clay_brick, granite, limestone, marble, rammed_earth.

material.description: Material name, e.g. limestone, granite, clay_brick, rammed_earth
